name: tree
description: A hierarchical list of nodes, one tab stop for the whole tree, where a parent opens and closes to show its children. The component renders the tree flat: the visible treeitems sit in order directly in the tree element, each with its level, set size and position. WAI-ARIA allows a treeitem directly in a tree, so there is no group element, and the three attributes carry the hierarchy the DOM does not.

requires.roles.label: the tree has aria-labelledby or aria-label
requires.roles.treeitem: treeitem, on every node the tree draws
requires.roles.expanded: aria-expanded on each parent node, true while its children are shown and false while they are hidden
requires.states.selected: aria-selected set to true on each selected node and false on the rest, when the tree offers selection
requires.states.level: aria-level on every node, 1 for a root and one more for each level below
requires.states.setsize: aria-setsize on every node, the count of its siblings drawn in the tree, the node included
requires.states.posinset: aria-posinset on every node, its 1-based place among its siblings
requires.states.multiselectable: aria-multiselectable set to true on the tree when more than one node can be selected at once
requires.focus.roving: one tab stop into the tree; exactly one node has tabindex 0 and the rest have tabindex -1
requires.keyboard.ArrowDown: moves focus to the next visible node
requires.keyboard.ArrowUp: moves focus to the previous visible node
requires.keyboard.ArrowRight: opens a closed parent; on an open parent moves focus to its first child; on a leaf does nothing
requires.keyboard.ArrowLeft: closes an open parent; otherwise moves focus to the parent of the node
requires.keyboard.Home: moves focus to the first visible node
requires.keyboard.End: moves focus to the last visible node
requires.keyboard.Space: selects the focused node, and toggles it when more than one node can be selected
requires.keyboard.TypeAhead: typing a character moves focus to the next visible node whose name starts with that character; typing several characters in rapid succession matches on the accumulated string
